titulo: 3.2 Update Details *Some Stats and numbers Modified*
html:
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.

With Spider-Man: Homecoming releasing in cinemas soon, we are pleased to be bringing you the Spider-Man: Homecoming update! This update contains 6 New Characters, 3 New Uniforms, New Special Missions as well as a whole host of other changes. Let’s take a look at what awaits you in Marvel Future Fight 3.2!



■ 6 New Characters!

Rhino, Lizard, Mysterio, Vulture, Sandman and Kraven the Hunter all join Marvel Future Fight.




* Sandman, Lizard, Rhino, Mysterio, and Kraven the Hunter are all available in the “Spidey’s Rouges Gallery“ Special Missions.
* Vulture is available only as an Enemy Shifter in “Spidey’s Rogues Gallery”, or via the 20 Daily Biometrics package.
* Numbers are based on skill level 1. 
* New team up bonuses and achievements for ranking up these characters has been added. 
* Numbers may change once the update is live


■ 3 New Uniforms added!

New uniforms for Spider-Man, Venom and Vulture have been added.



* New Uniforms are available for a discounted price for a short period. You will be able to check the uniforms specific features in the Uniform Room.


■ Character Improvements

Spider-Man and Iron Man will have their skills improved.

Spider-Man

Spider-Man is getting a rework this update. Spider-Man’s basic attack will be getting a slight range increase.


Spider-Man’s active skills will be changed according to the list below:



Due to the modifications to “Web Swing Kick”, the effect of the Captain America: Civil War uniform will also be changed.




Iron Man

Iron Man’s active skills have been modified.



■ New Special Missions

Spidey’s Rogues Gallery has been added. This new set of missions sees Spider-Man’s biggest enemies, The Sinister Six, take the floor in an attempt to finally defeat Spider-Man. Will your team be strong enough to stop the Sinister Six or will New York fall to the elite team of Super Villains?


As this is a new Special Mission, a new Quest Pack has been added. Make sure to complete the challenges involved and you will be rewarded with special rewards!




■ World Boss Ultimate: Ebony Maw and Supergiant added!

Two new World Boss Ultimate villains have been added. Are you strong enough to topple the super powered villains? Ebony Maw and Super Giant have been added to the Ultimate World Boss Rotation!


As there are now 5 World Boss Ultimate Stages, a new schedule has been added. On Sundays, you will now be able to challenge any of the World Boss Ultimate villains!

Monday: Proxima Midnight
Tuesday: Black Dwarf
Wednesday: Corvus Glaive
Thursday: Supergiant
Friday: Ebony Maw
Saturday: Ebony Maw
Sunday: All Bosses

■ Alliance Conquest Improvements

Alliance Conquest mode is seeing some improvements in Marvel Future Fight 3.2! These changes also include the much requested ‘Class 1’ alliance members being able to activate the Alliance skills.

Improved Character Management

You will now be able to see the current status of your teams whilst entering Alliance Conquest. You will also be able to see how many Alliance Tokens you have.

Also in the Character Management screen you will be able to sort your character list based on the status of your characters.



Alliance Conquest Authorization changes

Any member of an alliance will be able to apply for Alliance Conquest (previously only leaders could enter their alliance into alliance conquest).
*Cancelling the application is only possible for the Alliance Leader

Class 1 members of an Alliance will now be able to use the Alliance Conquest skills. The skill cools downs will be shared for all members of the Alliance, so make sure that you are coordinated with your Alliance to ensure that the skills are used to their fullest potential.

You can now also call your alliance to arms! You can send notifications to your Alliance members calling them to the fight!

■ New User Improvements
For those agents who are new to Marvel Future Fight, we are making some changes to the Tutorials and reward tracks for new users.

Tutorial Improvements
We have made some visual improvements to the tutorial story as well as some changes to the new player guides!



Heroes Journey/Journey of Growth Improvements
We have made some visual changes to the two new/returning user reward tracks. These improvements will automatically start at the first quest.

Character Selection Improvements
The available characters in the Heroes Journey has been increased! Most Characters are available to be chosen as the focus of the Heroes Journey. 
*Does not include: X-Gene Characters, Daily Biometrics Exclusive Characters or Native Tier-2 Characters


■ Other Changes

1. If you have already received the 1,500 assemble points, the red dot notification will be removed.
2. In Co-Op Play, the game will now remember your preference on if you want to automatically receive your progress rewards
3. When claiming items such as Phoenix Feathers and M’Kraan Crystals which have inventory limits from your mailbox, you will be able to claim over the maximum amount if your current total is below the maximum quantity.
          Eg. If you have 1900 M’Kraan Crystals, and purchase 1,000 more, you will be able to claim all 1,000 Crystals putting you over the 2,000 Crystal Limit.
          If you have 2900 M’Kraan Crystals, you will not be able to claim anymore from your mailbox.
※Note: If you collect the items individually from your inbox, you will be able to go slightly over the limit. However if you press the claim all button, you will not be able to exceed the limit
4. Epic Quest: Rise of the X-Men has been improved. Tracking Missions will now allow you to use Clear Tickets to clear immediately.
5. Epic Quest: Rise of the X-Men has been improved. You are now able to use the “View Mode” in Tracking Missions, Veiled Secrets and Common Enemy.
6. Epic Quest: Rise of the X-Men’s Tracking Missions have been improved. You can now see how many Biometrics can still be obtained for each stage in the chapter selection screen.
7. Character Rank scoring system has been modified.
8. In the Settings Menu, you can now select which push notifications you would like to enable/disable.

9. The screen when using biometric selectors has changed.

10. When looking through your characters, the find character menu now displays the name of the characters.

11. To help reduce file size, you can now download stage data the first time you enter a stage. If you wish to download all the stage data, go to Settings> Option> Download All Data
12. Searching for characters will now be sorted according to alphabetical order of your language.
13. Mission Status board will now be sorted in the following order: Available>Completed>Unopened Content
14. ISO-8 Boosters will now be stackable
15. Pop-up menus for sales (VIP package, Monthly Products) have been changed.
16. Recommended and Prohibited character lists for Timeline have been improved.
-Some banned heroes in Gold, Platinum and Vibranium Leagues will be changed, and X-Men Characters will be added.
17. Rogues Leadership skill “Adaptable” has been modified

18. First clear rewards for Story Missions have been changed. New Players will be able to get a 5☆ Iron Man, Black Widow and Captain America by chapter 3.
19. In the Hero Selection window, when trying to Tier-2 a character which does not reach the requirements to be advanced, a new pop-up will show stating the reasons why.

20. The following Known Issues from 3.1 have been fixed
-Alliance Chat showing that Magneto has been acquired from a Dimension Chest
-Story Mission portrait shortcuts not working correctly
- VIP healing not working correctly in the following areas: Tracking, Veiled Secret, Mutual Enemy
21. Ms. Marvel’s species has been changed from ‘Human’ to ‘Inhuman’. Hulkling’s Species has been changed from ‘Human’ to ‘Alien’.
